# Decisions

- [A dragged tab held against an end of the strip takes the first or last place](DVDV-4-a-dragged-tab-held-against-an-end-of-the-strip-takes-the-fir.md): The centre-passes-middle rule has one exception: a tab pushed all the way to an end of the strip takes the end place even if its centre has not passed the end neighbour's middle.
- [Build-history tests read squash-merged builds from the squash commit body](DVDV-2-build-history-tests-read-squash-merged-builds-from-the-squas.md): Tests that check a build's commit history fall back to the squash commit's '* subject' lines once the build branch was squash-merged into main.
- [Debug and Release builds are kept fully apart](DVDV-1-debug-and-release-builds-are-kept-fully-apart.md): Debug builds use their own bundle identifiers, data folder, socket, URL scheme and LaunchAgent label so they never touch the daily installed Helper.
- [Discovery parses dev:list --json, never the text table](DVDV-1-discovery-parses-devlist-json-never-the-text-table.md): Laravel Discovery runs php artisan dev:list --json and falls back to a fixed list on any failure, because the text table is cut and changes under agent environments.
- [Editing a Running Command applies at the next start](DVDV-1-editing-a-running-command-applies-at-the-next-start.md): Edits to a Running Command save at once and show a restart-to-apply hint; nothing restarts by itself.
- [Every Helper request carries an origin that drives notifications](DVDV-1-every-helper-request-carries-an-origin-that-drives-notificat.md): Requests that change Processes carry an origin (user, agent, autoRestart, fileChange), and NotificationRule decides banners from it.
- [Install never stops a running Helper; the App shows an outdated banner](DVDV-1-install-never-stops-a-running-helper-the-app-shows-an-outdat.md): scripts/install.sh swaps the app in place and leaves the running Helper alone, and the App compares builds and protocol versions to warn instead of restarting.
- [Launch at login uses a LaunchAgent file, not SMAppService](DVDV-1-launch-at-login-uses-a-launchagent-file-not-smappservice.md): The Helper's launch-at-login is a plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents because the login-item API breaks after every reinstall of an ad hoc signed build.
- [MCP tools match names case-insensitively and wait before answering starts](DVDV-1-mcp-tools-match-names-case-insensitively-and-wait-before-ans.md): MCP finds Projects and Commands by name without regard to case, defaults to the Project holding the working directory, and waits about 1 s after start or restart.
- [No way of ending a tab drag selects a tab](DVDV-4-no-way-of-ending-a-tab-drag-selects-a-tab.md): Drop, Esc, a vanished tab, lost focus and a closed window all end a tab drag without changing the selection, and each has a fixed outcome.
- [One AppKit overlay handles every mouse button on a tab](DVDV-4-one-appkit-overlay-handles-every-mouse-button-on-a-tab.md): Each output tab has a single AppKit catcher view (onTabPointer) for click, drag and middle click, instead of SwiftUI gestures or separate catchers.
- [Pointer behaviour nobody ran goes on the manual checklist and in the final report as not verified](DVDV-4-pointer-behaviour-nobody-ran-goes-on-the-manual-checklist-an.md): Behaviour that needs a person at the Mac is added to docs/manual-checklist.md as unchecked items and mirrored in docs/final-report.md as not verified, and tests read both files as text.
- [Pointer rules for tabs live in DevDevCore as pure value types](DVDV-4-pointer-rules-for-tabs-live-in-devdevcore-as-pure-value-type.md): What the mouse does on a tab is decided by TabPress, TabDrag and TabDragGeometry in DevDevCore, and the AppKit and SwiftUI code only feeds them events and draws the result.
- [Stop signals every process group in the Process's session](DVDV-1-stop-signals-every-process-group-in-the-processs-session.md): Stopping a Process sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to every process group in the session the child leads, not just the leader's group.
- [SwiftUI content in an NSPopover uses preferredContentSize sizing](DVDV-2-swiftui-content-in-an-nspopover-uses-preferredcontentsize-si.md): Any NSHostingController placed in an NSPopover sets sizingOptions to .preferredContentSize, and the menubar popover is built only through MenubarPopover.make.
- [Tab order is App state only, changes live during a drag, and is not saved](DVDV-4-tab-order-is-app-state-only-changes-live-during-a-drag-and-i.md): The order of output tabs lives only in WindowState.tabs in memory, is changed on every new place during a drag, and is never sent to the Helper or saved.
- [Tab shortcuts count places from the left and are never bound to a tab](DVDV-4-tab-shortcuts-count-places-from-the-left-and-are-never-bound.md): Cmd-1 to Cmd-9, Cmd-0, Cmd-Shift-[ and ] and the Window menu's Show Tab N always mean the tab at that place in the current order.
- [Tests run child processes with /bin/sh, not the login shell](DVDV-1-tests-run-child-processes-with-binsh-not-the-login-shell.md): The Shell is injectable; tests use /bin/sh -c so they do not depend on the user's shell setup, with one small test for the login-shell path.
